menu.name: Bike Cooldown: On-the-Bike 5 min

segments.name: Easy spin-down
segments.description: Light gear at ~60rpm to bring the heart rate down

segments.name: Calf release (right)
segments.description: On a safe straight, stand on the pedals and drop the right heel to stretch the calf

segments.name: Calf release (left)
segments.description: Repeat with the left heel dropped deep

segments.name: Shoulder & neck reset
segments.description: While stopped or somewhere safe, release one hand at a time and roll the shoulders to loosen the neck and traps

segments.name: Back & pelvis reset
segments.description: Alternate rounding and gently arching the back to release the posture held during riding

segments.name: Final easy spin
segments.description: Spin gently until breathing is fully settled, then finish

menu.description: An on-the-bike cooldown for the legs, calves and shoulders used through Warm-up, Main 1 and Main 2. Approx. calories: 20-30 kcal
